pairing.note: Unordered field + ink pairs (brand/decisions.md Part 2). Contrast limits: tokens/contrast-matrix.json.

tiers.large: 3 to 4.5:1: text 25 pt and up, bold labels and graphics
tiers.display: 2 to 3:1: display text 44 pt and up and graphics only
tiers.tonal: under 2:1: textures, marks and environment maps; no text

detail.use: Default dark pairing. Key-number slide (with the Crimson moment), investor covers, app default, signage. Any text size.
Workhorse content pairing on Honeydew (Site sections, tables). Peacock field + Honeydew for dividers and the app light alternative. Any text size.
Warm dark pairing. Sprig text on Blackmoss for premium pages, card backs, signage. Any text size.
Content on Honeydew with Cedar ink (chart pages), Cedar dividers, formal brand pieces. Any text size.
Warm content pairing (Sprig field, Peacock ink) for photo and detail slides. Any text size.
System and technical sections (Sprig field, Cedar ink); Cedar dividers with Sprig type. Any text size.
Premium accent: award, milestone or headline-figure slides; Citron type on Blackmoss. Any text size.
Premium accent on Peacock; headline figures and quotes. Any text size.
Dark data pages and dashboards: Sage type and chart context on Blackmoss. Any text size.

The earthy pairing: covers and closes, Economics, sustainability, land, agriculture and water sections, Olive dividers. Olive ink on Honeydew is body-safe (4.73:1); Crimson is not approved on Olive, so emphasis uses chips, highlighted tiles and bottom lines.
Warnings and the key-number moment on Blackmoss. Crimson type 25 pt and up.
Secondary dark content with Sage type; headlines 25 pt and up, labels, charts.
Warm accent on Cedar: headlines 25 pt and up, figures, icons.
Alert or key figure on Peacock; Crimson 25 pt and up.
Alerts, risk flags and past-due notices on Honeydew; Crimson type 25 pt and up or bold labels.
Earthy dark accent: Olive headlines 25 pt and up and graphics on Blackmoss.
Default cover and close (Sage field, Honeydew type), card fronts, hero lines. 25 pt and up; never body text (D18).
Earthy dark accent: headlines 25 pt and up, graphics.
Warm earthy pairing: Sprig field with Olive headlines 25 pt and up; sustainability graphics.
Tonal green: headlines 25 pt and up, charts (Sage context on Cedar).
Display only (44 pt and up) and graphics: sunlight accents, icons on Honeydew.

The warm urgency pairing (Guide 04's Crimson card): the alternative key-number moment on a warm briefing, action-required and deadline slides, incentive-deadline banners, signage alerts and campaign or social graphics. Display type 44 pt and up only; the supporting detail goes on the next slide or in notes. Counts as the deck's Crimson moment.

The calm natural pairing (lake and shallow water): section dividers, pull-quote and statement slides, brand-atmosphere backgrounds, card backs, social tiles and signage idle screens. Display type 44 pt and up and graphics only; never body text, captions, tables or charts.
Display only (44 pt and up) and graphics: forest and grove textures.
Tonal only: textures and marks; no text.
Tonal only: textures and marks; no text.
Tonal only: textures, the cover particle wave, marks; no text.
Tonal only: textures, watermark marks; no text.
Tonal only: textures and marks; no text.
Tonal only: textures, the premium background wave; no text.
